flags.md_text: [LPD] Lettres de Pierre Duhem à sa fille Hélène, Stanley L. Jaki (ed.), Paris: Beauchesne, 1994. [EHPS] Essays in History and Philosophy of Science, ed. and translation with Introduction by Roger Ariew and Peter Barker, Indianapolis: Hackett, 1996. [LAS] L’Aube du savoir: épitomé du système du monde (histoire des doctrines cosmologiques de Platon à Copernic), Anastasios Brenner (ed.), Paris: Hermann, 1997; selections from Duhem 1913–59. [CPT] Commentary on the Principles of Thermodynamics, ed. and trans. by Paul Needham, Cham: Springer, 2011.

spot.html_text: Duhem does not claim that when there is some conflict with experience, we can always make enough adjustments elsewhere in the system. He makes a weaker claim, also limited in other ways, but which would be equivalent to: when there is some conflict with experience what is disconfirmed is necessarily ambiguous.
